newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-yr yields end flat after early falls.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-yr yields end flat after early falls.

text.p: Benchmark three-year yields closed unchanged on Friday after early falls in the yields were erased by selling late in the session, dealers said.
They said the late selling was prompted by market talk that next week's new issues would be more than earlier expected.
"Next week's new issues were estimated at about 960 billion won, compared with 903 billion for this week," said a Hanwha Securities dealer.
Short-term cash liquidity showed little changes, with the average overnight call rate remaining at Thursday's rate of 15.5 percent, dealers said. --YOO CHOON-SIK (822) 727 5646
